description: Numerology calculations using Pythagorean or Chaldean systems. Life Path (birth date) = life purpose. Destiny/Expression (full name) = talents. Personality (consonants) = how others see you. Soul Urge (vowels) = inner desires. Personal Year = current year theme. Complete = all core numbers + pinnacle cycles. Compatibility = two-person comparison. Cost: $0.003-0.010/call.

birthDate.description: Birth date YYYY-MM-DD. Required for life-path, personal-year, complete.

name.description: Full name. Required for destiny, personality, soul-urge, complete.

year.description: For personal-year only — which year. Defaults to current.
